question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Lethargic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dynamic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lethargic"** refers to a state of being sluggish, drowsy, or lacking energy or enthusiasm. (सुस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** After a long day of work, he felt too lethargic to go out for dinner.
 
 
 
• **"Dynamic"** means characterized by constant change, activity, or progress; full of energy and new ideas. (गतिशील/सक्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a dynamic leader who constantly motivates her team to achieve their goals.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Lethargic"** is **"Dynamic"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dynamic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sluggish** (सुस्त): Lacking energy or alertness.

 
 
• **Example:** The hot weather made everyone feel sluggish and unwilling to work.
 
 
 
• **Sleepy** (नींद से भरा हुआ): Feeling drowsy or ready to fall asleep.
 
 
• **Example:** After the heavy lunch, he felt sleepy and decided to take a nap.
 
 
 
• **Dull** (मंद/नीरस): Lacking brightness, sharpness, or excitement.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that many students started to lose focus.
 
 

37:T529,
The correct answer is **option 4.**<
